sourceCopy.name: ICS Calendar Viewer
sourceCopy.title: ICS Viewer: Open Calendar Files Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Open and filter .ics calendar files in your browser. View recurring events and EXDATE exceptions locally, then export a CSV list.
sourceCopy.intro: View an iCalendar .ics file without connecting an online calendar. Filter events by date and text, expand supported recurring events and export the visible list as CSV.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I open an ICS calendar file?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Choose a local .ics file or paste its text, select a date range and view the matching events. The viewer expands supported daily, weekly, monthly and yearly rules and applies EXDATE exceptions.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The calendar is read in this browser only. UsefulVerse does not connect to your calendar account, upload the file or save your events.

fields.pasteHint: If both are provided, the selected file is used. The example shows a recurring event with an excluded date.
fields.privacy: No calendar account connection or network lookup. Floating times use your device’s local time; TZID times use their stated time zone.
fields.limits: Local limits: 5 MiB, 2,000 events, 10,000 displayed occurrences and a date range of up to 366 days. Complex files may use device memory; a computer is recommended.
fields.scope: Read-only ICS viewer. This is not a calendar editor or sync service. Unsupported recurrence options are reported rather than guessed.
fields.empty: No events match these dates and filters.

messages.noCalendar: Choose an ICS file or paste calendar text.
messages.invalid: Could not read this ICS calendar. Check its format and supported recurrence rules.
messages.tooLarge: The calendar exceeds the local 5 MiB limit.
messages.tooMany: This calendar exceeds the supported event or occurrence limit. Choose a smaller date range or file.
messages.noResults: No matching events in this date range.

additionalFaqs.question: Does the ICS viewer show recurring events?
additionalFaqs.answer: It expands daily, weekly, monthly and yearly rules in the selected date range and applies EXDATE exclusions. Unsupported recurrence options are rejected rather than guessed.

additionalFaqs.question: Can it connect to Google Calendar or Outlook?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It reads a file you choose or text you paste. It does not sign in, fetch an online calendar or sync changes.

additionalFaqs.question: Which time zone does it use?
additionalFaqs.answer: A TZID on an event is interpreted with that zone. UTC timestamps stay UTC; floating event times use your device time zone. The list is formatted in your browser’s local zone.
